text:
mara: heads-up, want to finalize the benchmark "slate slice" visual & launch routing today. goal: single hero that scales across blog OG, social, and webinar cover.

eli: quick ask  what does "slate slice" mean visually?

mara: compact 3-zone card: small latency spark (median+p95), center mini-scatter (latency vs $/1k) with shaded "hosted" vs "dedicated" lanes, right = micro-waterfall showing % savings (batching, quant, cache). no gridlines, minimal text.

benji: data from the most recent bench run: median=62ms/token, p95=210ms/token, baseline=$0.28/1k, optimized=$0.085/1k. uploading CSV to /marketing/bench/bench_5321112222.csv now.

claire: design notes: two hero variants in figma please: A) % deltas in hero B) $ amounts in hero. link: https://www.figma.com/file/slate-slice. keep OG overlay text <60 chars and high contrast.

ops-bot: Reminder: OG image min size 1200x630px. Include alt text and single-line transparency footer: "Tests run on model X, standard GPU; results vary by workload."

mara: copy tests: short headline A: "Predictable inference economics." B: "Latency you can rely on; costs you can control." Which should be OG?

eli: B for OG, A for CTA. B reads clearer on social.

benji: for the visual, add a tiny arrow callout for <128-token fastpath. many chat teams scan for that.

claire: noted. will add micro-annotation: "fastpath (<128 tokens)" and a dashed baseline line showing hosted default.

mara: routing: UTM campaign = slate_slice_launch_2026. demo CTAs -> SDR queue; enterprise interest -> AE queue with tag "bench-enterprise". sales-sdr to confirm form hidden field.

sales-sdr: confirmed. we'll add hidden field `bench_cohort=slate_slice` and routing rules: demo -> SDR-B, enterprise -> AE-priority. We'll also create a short SDR playbook with two qualifying questions: priority (latency/cost) and monthly token volume.

benji: uploading CSV and a small run-readme now. filename: /marketing/bench/bench_5321112222.csv. ping me if numbers change.

claire: timeline: figma frames by tomorrow 10am, final hero copy by mara by 1pm, blog target next Tue. I'll post both OG variants for quick A/B.

mara: also want a 1-paragraph hero blurb for the blog explaining tradeoffs and a CTA to the webinar. jamie, can you prep two alt CTAs for email? (short and long)

eli: tagging jamie (cc @jamie): we want a short CTA for OG: "See the benchmark" and a longer CTA for email: "Join our webinar to see how we get low latency and low unit cost without model changes."

claire: will include a tiny footer note in the image: "Baseline shown for comparison" so enterprise folks get context.

mara: perfect. once figma is up i'll pick the OG and lock the UTM. thanks team :rocket:
